subject: Request: one-time SSO extension for SOC 2 portal + evidence archival
messages:
From: Alex Reid <alex.reid@greenwoodadvisory.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Emily Thompson <emily.thompson@acme-corp.com>
Cc: audit-team@greenwoodadvisory.com
Date: Thu, 28 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Request: one-time SSO extension for SOC 2 portal + evidence archival

Hi Vanessa / Emily,

Thanks again for provisioning the trust portal. The audit field team for ACME is running into a scheduling conflict across EMEA/APAC and one of our senior reviewers will only be able to start review on Monday (their calendar changed). The current SSO invite shows it expires in 48 hours.

Two asks:
- Can Redwood issue a one-time SSO extension (or ephemeral SSO token) for +7 days so the reviewer can complete evidence download?
- After the engagement closes, can Redwood retain an archival copy of the evidence bundle for 90 days for audit traceability (read-only), or provide a timebound downloadable zip we can store in our secure storage?

We only need view and download rights for the attached evidence list (audit-request-ACME-2028.pdf). If you need an engagement ID or PO, happy to provide — engagement ID: GW-ACME-0628 if helpful.

Appreciate a quick heads-up on feasibility and any additional approvals you need on your side.

Best,
Alex Reid
Senior Manager, Audit Operations
Greenwood Advisory

Attachment: audit-request-ACME-2028.pdf (PDF, 128KB)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Reid <alex.reid@greenwoodadvisory.com>, Emily Thompson <emily.thompson@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 28 Jun 2028 10:03:12 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: one-time SSO extension for SOC 2 portal + evidence archival

Alex — thanks for the note and the engagement ID.

Quick answers: we can support a one-time extension, but we need to confirm a couple items before we issue an extended SSO token:
- Which specific documents/paths in the portal does the reviewer need? Please call them out (or confirm the attached PDF is exhaustive).
- We typically require an internal approval and an entry in HubSpot for traceability (I pasted the deal link below).

Options we can offer (pick one):
1) One-time SSO link (timeboxable, revokable) for +7 days — our preferred approach.
2) Ephemeral downloadable zip delivered via secure transfer (SFTP/Share) if SSO is not possible.

On archival: we can provide a timebound downloadable archive (90 days) or retain a read-only snapshot in the portal for that timeframe. We will need to coordinate with Security for the retention exception. If you confirm option 1, I'll loop Security and Compliance for approval and generate the token.

Neha / Marissa — FYI and requesting approval to issue a +7 day ephemeral SSO token for Greenwood Advisory (engagement GW-ACME-0628).

Alex — if you can confirm the final list of items and that reviewers are tied to the engagement ID, I'll expedite.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Lead, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
https://hubspot.redwood.ai/deal/ACME-2028
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 28 Jun 2028 10:15:00 -0400
Subject: Internal: Greenwood request — SSO extension + archival (GW-ACME-0628)

Neha / Marissa,

Summary: Greenwood (auditor) asked for a +7 day SSO extension for ACME review (engagement GW-ACME-0628) and a 90-day archival option after close. They provided the attached list (audit-request-ACME-2028.pdf).

Key considerations:
- Policy baseline: portal SSO invites default to 48 hours. Anything >48h requires compliance sign-off and Security to enable a revokable ephemeral token.
- Risk: extended exposure window + potential downstream storage of evidence by third party. We should limit scope to specific portal paths and enforce IP restrictions if possible.
- Suggested controls: one-time SSO token with IP allowlist, download-only rights, and automated revoke at end of window; add audit logging for all downloads (we already capture logs — sample attached: audit-log-sample.csv).

If you approve, I will:
1) Ask Security to generate the token with the above controls.
2) Share bridge-letter template with Greenwood confirming the extension and retention terms (I can attach the draft).
3) Update HubSpot with the activity.

Please advise: approve as-is, or request modifications?

Thanks — V.
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Alex Reid <alex.reid@greenwoodadvisory.com>
Date: Thu, 28 Jun 2028 11:02:15 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: one-time SSO extension for SOC 2 portal + evidence archival

Vanessa / Team / Alex — this is fine with the following conditions (we'll need to document in the bridge letter and HubSpot):

1) Limit the extension to the explicitly enumerated portal paths in audit-request-ACME-2028.pdf — no global tenant access.
2) Enforce download-only role for the extended token and apply an IP allowlist if Greenwood can provide the reviewer IP(s).
3) Extension will be exactly +7 days from issuance and will be revoked automatically after expiry; logs will be preserved for 12 months.
4) We will produce a short bridge-letter confirming the extension and retention posture; attaching the draft for your review.

Security (Marissa) — please generate the ephemeral SSO token with those controls and share the issuance audit record back to the thread.

Alex — if this works, please reply that Greenwood accepts the conditions and provide reviewer IP(s) if available. Once we have that confirmation, Vanessa will issue and I will circulate the bridge-letter (draft attached).

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachment: bridge-letter-acme-2028-draft.pdf (PDF, 42KB)
